rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for events, arrangements, or agreements that are not formal or official.

example.english: This gathering is informal, so just wear something comfortable.
example.traditional: 今次個聚會唔正式，着舒服啲就得。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 go3 zeoi6 wui6 m4 zing3 sik1 zoek6 syu1 fuk6 di1 zau6 dak1

rows.note: Use this specifically for clothing intended for ordinary everyday wear rather than formal dress.

example.english: Our company lets us wear informal clothes to work on Fridays.
example.traditional: 公司星期五容許我哋着便服返工。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 sing1 kei4 ng5 jung4 heoi2 ngo5 dei6 zoek6 bin6 fuk6 faan1 gung1

rows.note: Use this for language or wording associated with everyday speech rather than formal written usage.

example.english: Rewriting this article in informal language will make it sound much more natural.
example.traditional: 呢篇文章改做口語，讀落會自然好多。
example.jyutping: ne1 pin1 man4 zoeng1 goi2 zou6 hau2 jyu5 duk6 lok6 wui5 zi6 jin4 hou2 do1
